missionPremise: Zoning is a bulk ingest of public record. Per-city presence from the store, never a coverage percentage and never the ledger. Denominator is in-city parcels from landing_parcel_jurisdiction (disposition=in-city, method=ring). A city that serves a district on a placeholder setback-rule is not done. Source: compiled dispatch 2026-09-01_zoning-ingest and card premises.
completionPredicate: Per-city table for every roster city in the six counties (69 primary, 72 territory-touching) naming layer present/source/vintage/features and parcels serving a zoning.district. One no-layer city taken acquire-ingest-stamp-bake; every blocker named including solved ones; served setback stated as real-rule or placeholder. Remaining cities sized, not run. leave_behind named. Every count labelled real, placeholder, or both.
scopeBasis: Roster from _catalog/texas_roster_v1.json generated_at 2026-08-12T16:47:05.273Z. Layer presence from neondb.tx_zoning_district_staging, not Z1 close and not the ledger. Stamps from txgio_parcel.zoning_district joined to landing on (county_fips, prop_id) using DISTINCT prop_id because txgio_parcel is multi-row per parcel. Served district from place_layer_snapshots plus a live /facets second derivation on golds. Setback real vs placeholder from hauska_mcp setback-rule F1 CASE (storage-port-proof/phase-1a). Do not run a multi-city wave. Do not derive zoning from CAD or land use.

heavyScanPlan: One at a time. (1) staging GROUP BY city_key DONE. (2) landing per-city DONE. (3) stamp DISTINCT join — re-run after dupe finding. (4) served district from place_layer_snapshots by place_key = node:{fips}:{prop_id} plus live /facets on one parcel per class. (5) F1 setback-rule CASE per county, timeout 15s, re-derive 188103/158573. Neon MCP timed out on (4) and (5); continue via gcloud+psql.

blockersSeenAlready.what: Neon MCP timed out on place_layer_snapshots and atoms range scans. Switched to gcloud secret + local SQL with statement_timeout.
Stamp CLI and ZONING_LAYERS live in legacy-design-tools. Card repo is hauska-engine only. Wiring a new city requires an LDT change the card forbids touching.
Bake is county-wide Factory publish, not city-scoped. One-city bake still rewrites the county snapshot.
Real setback-rule for a no-layer city requires ordinance extraction + Z5 operator ratification + atoms write. Hays/Williamson/McLennan have zero non-placeholder rules.

falsifierPreregistered.placeholderAsDone: If a city is marked done because a district is served and F1 for that county is 100 percent placeholder, the close failed the card.
